Shop vendor is 'Revue Profane'.
qualifies_reason: Small independent French art review with issues 20, 21 and 22 published between June 2025 and May 2026.
what_it_is: A French biannual art review devoted to amateurs, self-taught makers and collectors working outside the official art world. Each issue mixes portraits, interviews and photo stories of people who create or collect for love rather than career, with experimental graphic design. It appeals to readers of art, craft and outsider culture, in French.
